Content repurposer — turn one blog post, video, or podcast into social posts, email newsletters, and threads. On-demand.

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of doctorclaw-content-repurposer.
- Transform a single blog post, video, or podcast into 8–12 pieces of content for multiple platforms (LinkedIn, X/Twitter, Instagram, Facebook, email, graphics, summary bullets).
- Customization options include brand voice, platform selection, audience targeting, content type, and hashtag strategy.
- Simple setup: just provide the content to repurpose (text, URL, or file).
- Step-by-step workflow for extracting key elements and generating tailored outputs per platform.
- Supports review, refinement, and (with integration) direct scheduling of approved posts.
